verses.text_urhobo: Sera tọnre ọ da dia akpọ ikpe ujosa gbẹ ighwrẹ, ena kọye ikpe ri Sera.
verses.text_romanized: sera tonre o da dia akpo ikpe ujosa gbe ighwre ena koye ikpe ri sera

verses.text_urhobo: Sera de ghwu vwi Kiriatharba (kọye Hebrọn) vwẹ otọ ri Kenan. Ebraham de vweri Sera ọ da viẹ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: sera de ghwu vwi kiriatharba koye hebron vwe oto ri kenan ebraham de vweri sera o da vie ke

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham de vrẹn nẹ asan orivwi na, o da ta kẹ ihwo ri Hẹt na,
verses.text_romanized: ebraham de vren ne asan orivwi na o da ta ke ihwo ri het na

verses.text_urhobo: Mẹvwẹ ọrharha ro won ovwan, wa kẹ vwẹ otọ vwẹ ọgbẹ rẹ ovwan na, rere mi shi orivwi mẹ phihọ.
verses.text_romanized: mevwe orharha ro won ovwan wa ke vwe oto vwe ogbe re ovwan na rere mi shi orivwi me phiho

verses.text_urhobo: Ihwo ri Hẹt na da kpahe kẹ Ebraham,
verses.text_romanized: ihwo ri het na da kpahe ke ebraham

verses.text_urhobo: Nyo avwanre, ọrovwavwanre; wẹ ọgba kugbe ovwiodje vwẹ ohri rẹ avwanre. Shi orivwi wẹn vwẹ ushi ro Me yovwi vwẹ ọgbọ na, ohwo rọ se kẹ wẹ herọ-ọ eyẹ ohwo sa kpọ wẹ unu-u.
verses.text_romanized: nyo avwanre orovwavwanre we ogba kugbe ovwiodje vwe ohri re avwanre shi orivwi wen vwe ushi ro me yovwi vwe ogbo na ohwo ro se ke we hero o eye ohwo sa kpo we unu u

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham de vrẹn o de diguẹ kẹ ihwo ri Hẹt na, re dia ihwo rẹ otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham de vren o de digue ke ihwo ri het na re dia ihwo re oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ ayen, Ovwan da rhọvwe nẹ mi shi orivwi mẹ na nẹ obaro mẹ, wa gba kerhọ, re ovwan rẹ Efrọn rẹ ọmọ ri Zohar,
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke ayen ovwan da rhovwe ne mi shi orivwi me na ne obaro me wa gba kerho re ovwan re efron re omo ri zohar

verses.text_urhobo: rere ọ kẹ vwẹ ẹmwa ri Mak-pela ro rhere na; ọ he obo oba rẹ otọ na. Uchunu ro muru ejobi e jo se vwẹ irharo rẹ ovwan re Me hwa, rọ dia ẹkẹn rẹ ogbe.
verses.text_romanized: rere o ke vwe emwa ri mak pela ro rhere na o he obo oba re oto na uchunu ro muru ejobi e jo se vwe irharo re ovwan re me hwa ro dia eken re ogbe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke yena yi Efrọn tidia vwẹ ohri rẹ ihwo ri Hẹt na, Efrọn rẹ ohwo ri Hẹt na da kpahe kẹ Ebraham vwẹ irharo rẹ ihwo ri Hẹt ejobi, vwẹ obọ rẹ ihwo ri kpo ughere rẹ orere na,
verses.text_romanized: oke yena yi efron tidia vwe ohri re ihwo ri het na efron re ohwo ri het na da kpahe ke ebraham vwe irharo re ihwo ri het ejobi vwe obo re ihwo ri kpo ughere re orere na

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹjo, ọrovwovwe, kerhọ mọ; Me kẹ wẹ otọ na, Me je kẹ wẹ ẹmwa rọ herọ, vwẹ irharo rẹ emọ rẹ ihwo mẹ mi de siobọ no kẹ wẹ, shi orivwi wẹn phihọ.
verses.text_romanized: ejo orovwovwe kerho mo me ke we oto na me je ke we emwa ro hero vwe irharo re emo re ihwo me mi de siobo no ke we shi orivwi wen phiho

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ebraham de shiguẹ otọ kẹ ihwo rẹ otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebraham de shigue oto ke ihwo re oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da ta kẹ Efrọn vwẹ irharo rẹ ihwo rẹ otọ na, Ẹkẹvuọvo odẹ je we, gba kerhọ mẹ, Me hwa unu rẹ igho rẹ otọ na muru kẹ wẹ; reyọ mie vwe, rere mi shi orivwi mẹ vwọ Etiyin.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da ta ke efron vwe irharo re ihwo re oto na ekevuovo ode je we gba kerho me me hwa unu re igho re oto na muru ke we reyo mie vwe rere mi shi orivwi me vwo etiyin

verses.text_urhobo: Efrọn da kpahe kẹ Ebraham,
verses.text_romanized: efron da kpahe ke ebraham

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwovwe, kerhọ mẹ, ubrotọ ra shẹre shẹkẹl uri ivẹ rẹ idọnọ efuanfon, kidie ọyena firi vwẹ uvwre mẹ vẹ owẹ? Shi orivwi wẹn phihọ
verses.text_romanized: orovwovwe kerho me ubroto ra shere shekel uri ive re idono efuanfon kidie oyena firi vwe uvwre me ve owe shi orivwi wen phiho

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham vẹ Efrọn da rhọvwe kugbe; Ebraham da vwavwe idọnọ efuanfon na kẹ Efrọn uchunu ro seri na vwẹ irharo rẹ ihwo ri Hẹt na, shẹkẹl uri ivẹ rẹ idọnọ efuanfon, kiri unu rẹ ineki vwanvwa ọke yena.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham ve efron da rhovwe kugbe ebraham da vwavwe idono efuanfon na ke efron uchunu ro seri na vwe irharo re ihwo ri het na shekel uri ive re idono efuanfon kiri unu re ineki vwanvwa oke yena

verses.text_urhobo: Ọtiọye na otọ ri Efrọn rọ i Mak-pela, rọ obọrhe ri Mamre, otọ na kugbe ẹmwa rọ herọ, kugbe irhe rẹ otọ na ejobi, o de siobọ no,
verses.text_romanized: otioye na oto ri efron ro i mak pela ro oborhe ri mamre oto na kugbe emwa ro hero kugbe irhe re oto na ejobi o de siobo no

verses.text_urhobo: kẹ Ebraham rọ dia ẹkẹn rọye vwẹ irharo rẹ ihwo ri Hẹt na, kugbe ihwo rẹ orere na re rhe ughere na ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: ke ebraham ro dia eken roye vwe irharo re ihwo ri het na kugbe ihwo re orere na re rhe ughere na ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Re enana ejobi vwọ wan nu, Ebraham de shi Sera rẹ aye rọye phihọ ẹmwa rọ otọ ri Mak-pela, vwẹ obọrhe ri Mamre (kọye Hebrọn) vwẹ otọ ri Kenan.
verses.text_romanized: re enana ejobi vwo wan nu ebraham de shi sera re aye roye phiho emwa ro oto ri mak pela vwe oborhe ri mamre koye hebron vwe oto ri kenan

verses.text_urhobo: Te otọ na kugbe ẹmwa rọ herọ ke siobọ no kẹ Ebraham rọ dia ẹkẹn rẹ ogbẹ, re ihwo ri Hẹt vwọ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: te oto na kugbe emwa ro hero ke siobo no ke ebraham ro dia eken re ogbe re ihwo ri het vwo ke

headings.text_urhobo: Ughwu ri Sera. Ebraham dẹ otọ re Shiro phihọ
headings.text_romanized: ughwu ri sera ebraham de oto re shiro phiho
